messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Removing Linkage Group
parts:
You can use the subset() function, with the chromosome argument; to omit a particular chromosome use its name with a minus sign in front of it:

  ti313 <- subset(ti313, chr="-L22")

Alternatively, subset using brackets, chromosomes in the first slot and individuals in the second.

  ti313 <- ti313["-L22", ]

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: Removing Linkage Group
parts:
names(ti313$geno) gives the chromosome names. Grab that, edit it, and then assign it back.

  chr <- names(ti313$geno)
  chr[chr=="L23"] <- "L22"
  chr[chr=="L24"] <- "L23"
  chr[chr=="L25"] <- "L24"
  names(ti313$geno) <- chr

karl
